d: Short, messy ash-white hair with choppy bangs and layered locks frames a youthful, energetic face. The wide, expressive eyes are a vibrant golden-yellow shade. A slender build is dressed in a white and blue futuristic outfit featuring a high collar and a pair of oversized bronze-tinted goggles resting around the neck. Signature details include a black and white mechanical headset with a blue cross emblem worn over the head.
